angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,085,988 km at 193.18 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.1765 +/- 0.0365 mas (same row, RUWE 1.94): 193.18 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 1.561 +/- 0.043 solar radii from Doyle et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-131 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.4499D/abstract): 1,085,988 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.06 +/- 0.068 solar masses from Doyle et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-131 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.4499D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5990 +/- 50 K from Doyle et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-131 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.4499D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Doyle et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-131 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.4499D/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-131.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.077, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-131 (pscomppars): spectral type G0, from Hellier et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.465.3693H/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 122173: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-131 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.2 dex, from Doyle et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.4499D/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-131 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.53005, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-131 (pscomppars): age 7 Gyr, from Doyle et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.4499D/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-131 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.8 km/s, from Doyle et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.4499D/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
